meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档变成可爱的幻灯片 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把文档快速变成可分享的叙事幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute slide-deck PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a document into shareable narrative slides

howto.what: 安装后,你把一份文档交给 Claude,它会生成一套可爱卡通风格的幻灯片 PDF;若配置了分享服务,还会额外给出一个手机版分享链接。整个过程自动在 NotebookLM 中完成。
howto.when: 当你说“Wowerpoint <文件>”“把这份报告做成幻灯片”等,或要求把单个文档变成可分享的叙述幻灯片时,该技能接管。

say.note: 把文档生成幻灯片 PDF,并尝试给手机版链接。

say.text: 把这份季度报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 自动调用 NotebookLM 生成可爱风格幻灯片。
按默认提示词生成卡通角色叙述的演示文稿。

howto.what_en: Claude turns one document into a kawaii-style slide-deck PDF and, if the share service is configured, a mobile-friendly share link. It uses NotebookLM to create a notebook, generate slides, download the PDF, and upload it.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'Wowerpoint <file>', 'Turn this report into slides', or similar asks to render one document as shareable slides.

say_en.note: Generates a slide PDF and tries a mobile link.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly report into slides
say_en.note: Uses NotebookLM to make a kawaii deck.
Runs the default kawaii narrative prompt.
